## TemplateManager.\_importCache property

Shared import-resolution cache reused across single-file reloads.

**Signature:**

```typescript
_importCache: Map<string, string>;
```

## Remarks

`_loadAllFiles` uses a batch-local cache; `_loadFile` reuses this persistent cache so repeated watcher reloads share resolutions.
